name: locomotives
label: Locomotives
provenance: Recalled from knowledge of British named steam classes (GWR Castle/Hall/Manor/King, LNER A1/A3/A4, LMS Princess/Duchess/Jubilee/Royal Scot, SR Merchant Navy/West Country/Battle of Britain, BR Standard/Clan), narrow-gauge Welsh and Cumbrian railways, early pioneers, US and continental types. Running numbers and apostrophes stripped; deliberately kept conservative rather than padded.
